claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation and ventilation.
Treat severe hyperkalemia (potassium 6.5 mEq/L) with calcium gluconate, insulin/glucose, and potassium binders; recheck potassium frequently.
Manage severe hepatocellular injury (AST 2799, ALT 1137) with serial liver enzymes and coagulation monitoring; evaluate for ischemia, viral, and drug-induced etiologies.
Continue sedation with midazolam and analgesia with fentanyl to maintain Richmond RASS goal of -1.
Maintain hemodynamic support with norepinephrine infusion and titrate to mean arterial pressure goal; monitor with arterial line and PiCCO.
Obtain blood and sputum cultures and continue broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected sepsis; reassess with lactate and clinical status.
Replete magnesium (1.7 mg/dL) and calcium (ionized 1.0 mmol/L) with IV magnesium sulfate and calcium gluconate.
Monitor and treat metabolic acidosis (pH 7.19-7.25, bicarbonate 18, lactate 3.1) with serial ABGs and optimization of perfusion.
Maintain glycemic control with insulin infusion or sliding scale, targeting glucose 140-180 mg/dL.
Perform daily sedation interruption and spontaneous breathing trial assessment when clinically appropriate.
